name: – Ana Catarina Mendes – § 3 – Am 7
title: REPORT on the Commission’s 2024 Rule of Law Report
part_text: 3. Stresses the need for the impartiality of prosecutors and judges; emphasises that the political or personal opinions of these practitioners must not influence court rulings, and that otherwise, there is a risk of politicising the judiciary and of interfering with democratic and electoral processes; recalls that the appointment and promotion of judges must be determined solely by their qualifications and not be influenced by political or personal considerations, as the judges essential for safeguarding judicial independence; recalls that the criteria for nominations and appointments to high-level judicial positions must be fully transparent;
